miniProject.title: Exploration bonuses with honest multi-seed evaluation
miniProject.brief: Extend `policylab` with exploration bonuses and a hardened evaluation harness over small bandit, grid and sparse-goal tasks. Compare optimistic, count-based and predictor-error methods under matched budgets with robust aggregates. Every claim keeps per-run records, tuning isolation and a shift battery behind it.
steps: Build small bandit and grid tasks in `envs/` with an `oracles/` regret reference, then compare \(\epsilon\)-greedy against UCB under matched interaction budgets, reporting counts, gaps and regret across seeds.

Add a tabular count bonus and its pseudocount form plus an RND-style predictor-error bonus in `deep/`, checking each against a hand-derived reward mix and scoring extrinsic reward only with a noisy distractor cell present.

Log visitation and success coverage on a sparse task in `eval/`, compare shaped against sparse rewards with the success rule fixed, and complete a fairness checklist covering interaction counts, information access and tuning effort.

Test goal relabeling on a small sparse-reward task with substituted goals and recomputed rewards across final and future strategies, and add a history-stacking baseline on a delayed-observation variant.
Record a versioned environment and wrapper manifest in `envs/`, prove termination-versus-truncation bootstrapping with a dedicated test, and keep a wrapper-difference control that flips a ranking.

Build a versioned `eval/` harness with separate seed streams and deterministic plus stochastic modes, retain every attempt under a fixed checkpoint rule, mask vector autoreset steps, write a throughput note naming hardware and versions, and pass the rliable tests before reporting robust aggregates.

Compare two methods under a written four-counter budget in `ledger/` with one tuning allowance each, median-over-seeds scoring and an isolated final seed set, then run a four-factor shift battery with failures retained and a deployment boundary naming retraining triggers.
deliverables: Bonus and relabeling suite in `envs/`, `deep/` and `oracles/` with manifests and bootstrap tests.
Versioned `eval/` harness with per-run records, rliable aggregates and the throughput note.
Matched-budget comparison, shift battery and deployment boundary with all failures retained.

checks.name: rliable test suite: metrics and library tests
checks.note: Pass the named tests on CPU, then compute aggregates on retained run records.

rubric.pass: \(\epsilon\)-greedy and UCB runs share matched budgets with counts, gaps and regret across seeds, and manifests rebuild the tasks.
rubric.strong: A wrapper-difference control flips a ranking, and the bootstrap test separates termination from truncation.

rubric.pass: Count, pseudocount and predictor-error bonuses match hand-derived mixes, and task scores use extrinsic reward only.
rubric.strong: A noisy distractor cell shows the bonus decaying with visits while extrinsic success stays reported apart.

rubric.pass: Visitation and success coverage sit beside return, the shaped-versus-sparse run fixes its success rule, and relabeling recomputes rewards.
rubric.strong: Future and final relabeling are ranked from evidence, and the history baseline names what recurrence would still add.

rubric.pass: The harness keeps per-run records with isolated finals, rliable aggregates carry intervals, and every attempt is retained.
rubric.strong: Profiles with bands plus a shift battery defend the boundary, with retraining triggers written down.

miniProject.feedsInto: `deep/` bonuses, `envs/` tasks, `eval/` harness and `ledger/` budgets feed offline, model-based and language-policy projects and the capstone.
